elements.description:
A configuration version moving through environments: the pipeline, what changed, the evaluation evidence, the
approvals, the rollout and the rollback target, with a gated, confirmed Promote and a confirmed Roll back.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading, e.g. which assistant this configures

properties.name: stages
properties.description: The environments in order, each with the version it runs and any rollout in progress

properties.name: versions
properties.description: Every version the stages, the candidate and the rollback target refer to

properties.name: candidate
properties.description: The id of the version being promoted

properties.name: target
properties.description: The id of the stage it's promoted to; unset, the stage after the last one that fully runs it

properties.name: changes
properties.description: What changed against the version it replaces, by area

properties.name: evidence
properties.description: The evaluation behind the promotion; unset, promotion waits for one

properties.name: rollback
properties.description: Where Roll back goes; unset, there's nothing to roll back to

properties.name: hold
properties.description: A reason that holds every promotion, e.g. "Releases are frozen until Monday"

properties.name: promoteNote
properties.default: "Traffic moves as your release process sets it. You can roll back afterwards."
properties.description: Said in the promote confirmation, under the move

properties.name: rollbackNote
properties.default: "Only this stage changes. Other stages keep the versions they run."
properties.description: Said in the rollback confirmation, under the move

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-promote
events.description: Promote was confirmed ({ version, stage, from }: ReleasePromoteEvent); cancelable – prevented, the stage isn't marked "Requested"

events.name: tc-rollback
events.description: Roll back was confirmed ({ stage, from, to }: ReleaseRollbackEvent); cancelable – prevented, the stage isn't marked "Requested"

events.name: tc-compare
events.description: Compare was pressed – open the full diff ({ from, to }: ReleaseCompareEvent); cancelable, with nothing else to stop

props.name: onPromote
props.description: Promote was confirmed: start the move. Call `event.preventDefault()` if it can't start, so the stage isn't marked "Requested"

props.name: onRollback
props.description: Roll back was confirmed: start it. Call `event.preventDefault()` if it can't start, so the stage isn't marked "Requested"

props.name: onCompare
props.description: Compare was pressed: open the full diff between the two versions
